related.title: NG-PON2：TWDM 波長負載平衡
related.titleEn: NG-PON2: load balancing across TWDM wavelengths
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：由另一學徒只使用交付檔案重建兩情境與判定；需同時保留未通過情境。 教學應用要求8 Gbit/s；0.90組達標、0.75組不足，需另驗每用戶公平性。 goodput_counters.csv與逐層效率瀑布圖 保留輸入、逐項中間值、名義 8.55 與變更 7.125 Gbit/s、反例、驗收判定與模型限制，供另一學徒從零重算。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: A second apprentice must reconstruct both scenarios and decisions using only the handover files; retain failing cases as well. Teaching application requirement8 Gbit/s:0.90 passes and0.75 fails; per-user fairness remains a separate test. goodput_counters.csv and layer-efficiency waterfall Preserve inputs, intermediate values, nominal 8.55 and changed 7.125 Gbit/s, counterexamples, acceptance decisions and model limits so another apprentice can reproduce them.
related.difference: 完成兩組條件的可重算判定，指出哪些觀察能區分原因。 教學峰值使用率不超0.8；搬移前失敗、後通過；搬移中斷需單獨列入驗收。
related.differenceEn: Produce reproducible decisions for both configurations and identify observations that discriminate causes. Teaching peak utilization limit0.8: before fails and after passes; migration interruption requires separate acceptance.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 合成線速10 Gbit/s、框架有效0.95、封包有效0.90；變更封包有效0.75。 名義式 10*0.95*0.9 = 8.55 Gbit/s；變更式 10*0.95*0.75 = 7.125 Gbit/s。逐項標示量綱，先代入未四捨五入數值再作比較。 手算名義式並保存所有中間項，實作下列獨立驗證而非只抄最終數字： 從固定時間窗的線端位元、承載位元及應用位元三個計數器獨立求比；教學10不作精確標準線速聲明。

合成4波長各10 Gbit/s，負載[9,3,3,3]；將第一波長3 Gbit/s移到第二，成[6,6,3,3]。 名義式 max(9,3)/10 = 0.9 peak utilization；變更式 max(6,3)/10 = 0.6 peak utilization。逐項標示量綱，先代入未四捨五入數值再作比較。 手算名義式並保存所有中間項，實作下列獨立驗證而非只抄最終數字： 逐波長求和前後皆18 Gbit/s；畫熱點而非只報45%平均使用率。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Synthetic line rate10 Gbit/s, framing efficiency0.95 and packet efficiency0.90; change packet efficiency to0.75. Nominal 10*0.95*0.9 = 8.55 Gbit/s; changed 10*0.95*0.75 = 7.125 Gbit/s. Label dimensions, substitute unrounded values and only then compare. Calculate the nominal expression with intermediate terms and implement this independent validation rather than copying the final number: Independently compare line, bearer and application bit counters over one interval; the teaching10 is not a precise standard line-rate claim.

Synthetic four10 Gbit/s wavelengths carry[9,3,3,3]; move3 Gbit/s from first to second, yielding[6,6,3,3]. Nominal max(9,3)/10 = 0.9 peak utilization; changed max(6,3)/10 = 0.6 peak utilization. Label dimensions, substitute unrounded values and only then compare. Calculate the nominal expression with intermediate terms and implement this independent validation rather than copying the final number: Per-wavelength sums remain18 Gbit/s; plot the hotspot rather than reporting only45% mean utilization.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Dunant：空間分割多工容量取捨
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：由另一學徒只使用交付檔案重建兩情境與判定；需同時保留未通過情境。 教學應用要求8 Gbit/s；0.90組達標、0.75組不足，需另驗每用戶公平性。 goodput_counters.csv與逐層效率瀑布圖 保留輸入、逐項中間值、名義 8.55 與變更 7.125 Gbit/s、反例、驗收判定與模型限制，供另一學徒從零重算。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: A second apprentice must reconstruct both scenarios and decisions using only the handover files; retain failing cases as well. Teaching application requirement8 Gbit/s:0.90 passes and0.75 fails; per-user fairness remains a separate test. goodput_counters.csv and layer-efficiency waterfall Preserve inputs, intermediate values, nominal 8.55 and changed 7.125 Gbit/s, counterexamples, acceptance decisions and model limits so another apprentice can reproduce them.
related.difference: 完成兩組條件的可重算判定，指出哪些觀察能區分原因。 教學單方向需求220 Tbit/s；A通過、B不足；仍需單獨查海纜電力與放大器設計。
related.differenceEn: Produce reproducible decisions for both configurations and identify observations that discriminate causes. Teaching one-direction demand220 Tbit/s:A passes andB falls short; cable power and amplifier feasibility remain separate checks.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 合成線速10 Gbit/s、框架有效0.95、封包有效0.90；變更封包有效0.75。 名義式 10*0.95*0.9 = 8.55 Gbit/s；變更式 10*0.95*0.75 = 7.125 Gbit/s。逐項標示量綱，先代入未四捨五入數值再作比較。 手算名義式並保存所有中間項，實作下列獨立驗證而非只抄最終數字： 從固定時間窗的線端位元、承載位元及應用位元三個計數器獨立求比；教學10不作精確標準線速聲明。
合成方案A為12對纖、每方向每纖20 Tbit/s；方案B為8對、每纖25 Tbit/s，均以單方向計。 名義式 12*20 = 240 Tbit/s；變更式 8*25 = 200 Tbit/s。逐項標示量綱，先代入未四捨五入數值再作比較。 手算名義式並保存所有中間項，實作下列獨立驗證而非只抄最終數字： 逐纖建立清單相加，再檢查雙向總量若需報告應另乘2；不得同時計纖對與雙向而重複加倍。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Synthetic line rate10 Gbit/s, framing efficiency0.95 and packet efficiency0.90; change packet efficiency to0.75. Nominal 10*0.95*0.9 = 8.55 Gbit/s; changed 10*0.95*0.75 = 7.125 Gbit/s. Label dimensions, substitute unrounded values and only then compare. Calculate the nominal expression with intermediate terms and implement this independent validation rather than copying the final number: Independently compare line, bearer and application bit counters over one interval; the teaching10 is not a precise standard line-rate claim.

Synthetic planA uses12 fiber pairs at20 Tbit/s per fiber per direction; planB uses8 pairs at25 Tbit/s, consistently counting one direction. Nominal 12*20 = 240 Tbit/s; changed 8*25 = 200 Tbit/s. Label dimensions, substitute unrounded values and only then compare. Calculate the nominal expression with intermediate terms and implement this independent validation rather than copying the final number: Sum a per-fiber inventory; multiply by two separately only for a bidirectional report, avoiding double-counting pairs and directions.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
